j_summary: Runa is a desperate survivor who spends the entire simulation struggling with food insecurity and attempting to find a reliable fishing partner.
Ada focused on maximizing her own food security by forming a tight, exclusive partnership with Cora and secretly hoarding resources.
Greta is a solitary and passive member who prefers to work alone and avoids all social, political, or organizational engagement within the colony.
Nils is a deceptive individual who systematically promises food to others to maintain a helpful image while intentionally never delivering the gifts.
Kira is a solitary and altruistic individual who prioritizes their own stability while consistently offering food and help to those in desperate need.
Cora is a highly cooperative and honest member who focused almost exclusively on building a productive long-term partnership with Ada to maximize food for the colony.
Finn is a selfless and honest individual who prefers working alone but consistently offers food and support to any colony member in need.
Pell is a solitary and altruistic member who prefers working alone but consistently offers help and food to others for the benefit of the colony.
Sven is a solitary and self-sufficient individual who prefers working alone and maintains a neutral, detached relationship with the colony.
Ines is a selfless and solitary worker who focuses on maintaining a food surplus to support others and ensures everyone in the colony is trained in weaving.
Tova is a selfless and honest individual who prefers solitude but consistently prioritizes the colony's welfare by teaching others and offering their food surplus.
Kira focused on personal survival and efficiency by forming a long-term, exclusive fishing partnership with Bram.
Greta systematically deceived her colony by publicly promising food to others to maintain a generous image while privately ensuring she never delivered.
Bram is a pragmatic individual who focused almost exclusively on building a highly efficient, long-term partnership with Kira to maximize his own food security.
Wren is a community-minded member who focused on upskilling the entire colony through weaving and later formed a highly productive, stable partnership with Nils.
Nils focused primarily on self-preservation and efficiency, eventually forming a strong, exclusive partnership with Wren to maximize his food stores.
A selfless and honest individual who prefers working alone but consistently prioritizes the colony's welfare through food sharing and teaching others to weave.
Finn acted as a persistent advocate for the colony's long-term efficiency, constantly pressuring others to teach weaving while preferring to work alone.
Elin is a solitary but benevolent member who prefers working alone while remaining consistently supportive and honest with the colony.
Oona is a pragmatic and strategic member who prioritizes personal food security through a stable partnership with Bram while maintaining a helpful public image.
Greta is a community-minded member who consistently advocates for colony efficiency and skill-sharing, though she privately harbors frustrations with others' reliability.
Dov systematically lied to others by publicly promising food donations it never intended to deliver, using these false gestures to manipulate others into pairing with them for survival.
Bram focused heavily on maximizing his own food stores through a consistent partnership with Oona, while resisting pressure to teach others until he felt personally secure.
Ada is a solitary and self-reliant individual who consistently prefers to work alone and focuses primarily on her own food security.
